scope.purpose: Targeted follow-up research to resolve or narrow caveats discovered during section-level research. This is research-only candidate data and is not runtime app data.

resolvedCaveats.finding: Naturkartan and OSM both preserve exact continuity at the Abiskojaure section boundary. Naturkartan sections 1 and 2 share 68.286000203,18.590492322 with 0 m gap and about 31.1 m distance to STF Abiskojaure. OSM sections 1 and 2 share 68.286052708,18.590396212 with 0 m gap and about 32.2 m distance to the hut.
resolvedCaveats.importConsequence: The remaining decision is not factual but a normalization convention: either keep continuous section-boundary points or deduplicate/model the Kamajakka hut access as shared connector metadata.

resolvedCaveats.finding: Naturkartan site 12850 API/page geometry exists and reports a single 460-point line of about 14.023 km from 68.358896048,18.779224884 to 68.286000203,18.590492322. Direct public GPX for the section still returned HTTP 500 during the caveat pass.
resolvedCaveats.importConsequence: Planning-grade geometry source is identified. A stable downloadable official GPX/KML/GeoJSON remains unavailable for section 1, so source policy and capture method must be decided before runtime geometry import.

resolvedCaveats.finding: No official current closure, reroute or bridge-out notice was found for section 1 as of 2026-04-29. The 2025-08-06 AllTrails bridge-closure report remains anecdotal and unidentified; official/current sources still describe Nissunjohka and Kamajakka bridge access as route features.
resolvedCaveats.importConsequence: Do not encode the AllTrails report as a standing closure. Retain it only as a dated condition-report caveat and recheck official current pages before public/runtime use.

resolvedCaveats.finding: The Abisko National Park exit on section 2 was resolved by overlaying official Naturkartan GPX evidence against the NVR Abisko polygon. Approximate exit coordinate: 68.268303887,18.580143337. It is about 2.21 km southbound from the Abiskojaure GPX start and lies between GPX points 68.268366181,18.580138295 and 68.268191064,18.580152469.
resolvedCaveats.importConsequence: Abisko National Park camping/fire/dog/drone/hunting restrictions apply at the section start and stop after this boundary. General allemansratten, reindeer/dog control, fire-ban, fishing and hunting permit rules continue beyond the park.

resolvedCaveats.finding: STF lists the Alesjaure boat as a private optional shortcut, not a required Kungsleden crossing. Operator/contact: Roland Enoksson. Departures from STF Alesjaure are 10:00, 15:00, 17:00 and 18:30; from the outlet pier 10:30, 15:30, 17:30 and 19:00. Extra trips are offered 08:00-20:00 with at least 6 people. Price evidence: adult 500 SEK, child 200 SEK, extra backpack 200 SEK, dog free. Payment evidence: Swedish cash, EUR/NOK and card; no Swish evidence found.
resolvedCaveats.importConsequence: Model as optional shortcut/access metadata only. Do not use boat geometry as mandatory section geometry. Recheck directly before public use because the available STF page is a 2025 until-further-notice source rather than an explicitly 2026 operator page.

resolvedCaveats.finding: The stage divider at Tjaktja is clear in STF/Naturkartan stage text, but verified hut-spur geometry remains unavailable. STF Tjaktja is 68.051648,18.241082. Naturkartan's nearest combined-route line point is 68.051278650,18.246285616, about 220.1 m from the hut. OSM sections 3/4 share 68.049123502,18.245140770, about 327.5 m from the hut.
resolvedCaveats.importConsequence: Do not synthesize a hut spur for navigation. Later normalization must choose between hut POI endpoint plus connector metadata or continuous mainline section boundary.
resolvedCaveats.confidence: high for measured gaps; low for any inferred spur

resolvedCaveats.finding: Sielmmanjira ford coordinate is resolved well enough for a route-hazard note at 68.061904,18.253420 from Naturkartan text plus OSM support. Tjaktja capacity contradiction should be normalized to the current STF range 11-25 and stale OSM/Naturkartan exact 33 should be suppressed unless reverified.
resolvedCaveats.importConsequence: Use the ford as a hazard/route note with medium-high confidence. Avoid importing exact Tjaktja capacity 33.

resolvedCaveats.finding: Tjaktjapasset rest shelter coordinate is resolved at 68.019682,18.246937 with latrine at 68.019638,18.247057. The main bridge before Salka is medium-high confidence at 67.972246,18.263515.
resolvedCaveats.importConsequence: Shelter can be treated as a high-confidence facility. Latrine and bridge import depend on app taxonomy.
resolvedCaveats.confidence: high for shelter; medium-high for bridge

resolvedCaveats.finding: Section 5 bridge and shelter facts are now source-backed enough for research handoff. Gaskkasjohka bridge cluster coordinates: 67.927352,18.286078; 67.924985,18.286963; 67.922209,18.287163; 67.920577,18.291163. Guobirjohka bridge/rest point: 67.897503,18.328526. Kuoperjakka/Kebnekatan shelter: official 67.891744,18.322880, OSM shelter 67.891783,18.322867, dry toilet 67.891516,18.323050. Singi parent hut and junction are high confidence, but child amenities should be folded unless standalone emergency/toilet import is supported.
resolvedCaveats.importConsequence: Import shelter if shelter taxonomy exists; fold/import dry toilet depending on taxonomy. Avoid over-naming bridge cluster records. Suppress informal camp/meditation/wet-camp OSM pins and represent them as generalized route context.

resolvedCaveats.finding: NVR WFS bbox checks around the route corridor returned no current national park, nature reserve or current reserve features for sections 3-5. N2000 WFS returned only SE0820430 Torne och Kalix alvsystem. Kebnekaise proposed national park is a planning/proposal layer, not current legal protected-area rules.
resolvedCaveats.importConsequence: No current land-reserve rule should be inferred for sections 3-5 from this pass. A final selected-geometry line and watercourse crossing overlay is still needed before rules normalization because the Torne/Kalix Natura 2000 water-system layer may affect watercourse context rather than broad land access.

resolvedCaveats.finding: No official current closure, reroute or bridge-out notice for sections 1-5 was found as of 2026-04-29. Lanstyrelsen 2026-03-27 and 2026-04-22 winter-route warnings are spring/ice safety warnings, not summer hiking closures. No 2026 summer snow report was found; the STF snow report remains historical dated 2025-07-08. No active Norrbotten county fire-ban notice was found on checked official pages, but no-ban status is not durable.
resolvedCaveats.importConsequence: Use no-current-official-closure only as an accessed-date research statement. Recheck official current pages, bridge reports, fire bans, hunting/reindeer restrictions and hut service dates immediately before public/runtime use.

resolvedCaveats.finding: STF hut staffing for sections 1-5 is listed as 2026-02-20 to 2026-04-19 and 2026-06-18 to 2026-09-13 for Abiskojaure, Alesjaure, Tjaktja, Salka and Singi. Shop status: Abiskojaure, Alesjaure and Salka have shops with large selection; Tjaktja and Singi have no shop and require hikers to carry food.
resolvedCaveats.importConsequence: Encode shop/resupply only where taxonomy supports it and keep hut opening dates as currentness-sensitive metadata. Recheck before public use.

connectorAndAccessFindings.finding: The Laddjujavri boat is relevant only to the Nikkaluokta-Kebnekaise-Singi access corridor. STF explicitly says Singi-Nikkaluokta is not official Kungsleden. The boat shortens the Kebnekaise-Nikkaluokta access walk by about 6 km. OSM landing coordinates: east/lower 67.845181,18.887993 and west/higher 67.853000,18.789310.
connectorAndAccessFindings.importConsequence: Do not model the Laddjujavri boat as a section 5 or mainline Kungsleden crossing. If later access connectors are included, recheck 2026 schedule because Enoks still showed summer 2025 timetable/prices in this pass.
connectorAndAccessFindings.confidence: high for relevance; medium for current schedule

connectorAndAccessFindings.finding: Nikkaluoktaexpressen summer 2026 service is published for 2026-06-12 to 2026-09-20. Timetable PDFs are split for 2026-06-12 to 2026-08-02, 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-09, and 2026-08-10 to 2026-09-20. Adult Kiruna-Nikkaluokta online one-way fare is 300 SEK; onboard purchase is online price plus 200 SEK. Nikkaluokta bus stop coordinate from OSM: 67.850883,19.016419.
connectorAndAccessFindings.importConsequence: Relevant to Singi/Kebnekaise/Nikkaluokta connector access, not sections 1-5 mainline endpoints. Use booking/PDF for exact dates because times and connections vary.

connectorAndAccessFindings.finding: Abisko Turiststation remains valid section 1 access. STF says daily trains stop at unmanned Abisko Turiststation opposite STF, about 5 minutes' walk across E10; bus/transfer from Kiruna is via Lanstrafiken with some airport trips requiring a Kiruna change. Coordinates: STF Abisko 68.358392,18.783634; rail halt 68.357442,18.782515; bus stops 68.357858,18.781659 and 68.358419,18.778829.
connectorAndAccessFindings.importConsequence: Major 2026 caveat: Trafikverket platform works fully close Abisko Turiststation platform in ISO weeks 35-36, 2026-08-24 to 2026-09-06, with replacement transport by train operator.

connectorAndAccessFindings.finding: Road to Ritsem is out of scope for sections 1-5 mainline but relevant for later Vakkotavare/Ritsem access. Summer 2026 bus connects Gallivare with Kebnats/Saltoluokta, Stora Sjofallet, Suorva, Vakkotavare and Ritsem. Service is affected by planned rail-work train irregularity. Tur 1 runs 2026-07-18 to 2026-09-05. Tur 2 outbound runs 2026-06-22 to 2026-08-30 and inbound 2026-06-23 to 2026-08-31. Vakkotavare bus stop 67.581543,18.101005; Ritsem Fjallstation stop 67.722536,17.468211.
connectorAndAccessFindings.importConsequence: Do not use as access for sections 1-5. Carry forward for later sections around Vakkotavare/Ritsem and recheck booking partners for exact 2026 departures.

stillOpenImportPolicyDecisions: Confirm project source/licensing policy before storing or importing Naturkartan API/GPX geometry or OSM-derived route geometry.

Choose endpoint convention for hut-adjacent stages: hut POI endpoints, continuous section-boundary points, or explicit connector/access metadata. This remains relevant at Abiskojaure, Tjaktja, Salka and Singi.
Decide whether child facilities such as hut toilets, saunas, emergency phones, water points and dry toilets should be standalone POIs or folded into parent hut/shelter records.
Decide whether route bridges should be imported as standalone infrastructure POIs, represented as route notes, or suppressed unless they affect access/safety.
Run final protected-area/Natura 2000 line overlay against the selected geometry before rules normalization, especially for Torne och Kalix alvsystem watercourse crossings.
Recheck official current conditions, fire bans, hut opening/service dates, boat/bus timetables, hunting/reindeer restrictions and any bridge notices immediately before public/runtime import.

perSectionRecommendations.recommendation: Keep section research ready for normalization with caveats. Treat AllTrails bridge report as unconfirmed dated field report, not current closure. Use API geometry as planning-grade if source policy allows; direct official GPX remains unavailable. Keep Abiskojakka viewpoint pending and import Abiskojaure beach only if bathing POIs are in scope.

Add the Abisko National Park exit coordinate to rules normalization notes. Model Alesjaure boat as optional shortcut/access metadata with 2025-until-further-notice currentness caveat. Use resolved Siellajohka and Radunjarga coordinates for facilities if taxonomy supports them.
Use current STF Tjaktja capacity range 11-25. Add Sielmmanjira ford coordinate as route-hazard note. Keep Tjaktja hut-spur geometry unresolved and do not create synthetic navigation geometry.

Treat Tjaktjapasset shelter coordinate as resolved. Keep endpoint/spur and geometry source decisions as normalization policy. Suppress OSM-only picnic/meditation/camp examples unless independently verified.
Treat Kuoperjakka shelter/toilet and bridge cluster findings as research-ready. Keep Singi-Kebnekaise/Nikkaluokta as connector/access metadata. Do not import informal OSM camp/rest/meditation pins.
